moves.text: I welcome Douglas as counsel, then reverse the presumption: his authorship proves creative influence, not present authority. I ask him to label every sentence as history, interpretation, or permission. The rehearsal stops whenever those categories blur.

Agnolo projects the receipt: one failed authorized read, zero bytes, unknown cost, unknown reuse rights. I escalate the comedy by asking Douglas to clear the blocked Space. He can diagnose the absurdity, but only the repaired profile and professional review can move the gate.

I let the room wait after Douglas says, “I wrote it.” No one treats the silence as consent. Borges names the missing record; Agnolo names the missing authorization. I answer only with a narrower creative proposal that does not depend on protected expression.

I place three cards on the lectern: AUTHORSHIP, INFLUENCE, AUTHORIZATION. Douglas may rearrange them, but cannot merge them. The blocked receipt becomes the callback: a status URL and a fictional lawyer are objects in the scene, not evidence of delivery or clearance.
